description: Small FAISS comparison: native FAISS (Python) vs Bit OpenMP comparators (C). Single source of truth for scripts/faiss_compare.pl. Telemetry is disabled: only per-iteration timings are harvested. The script auto-detects the repo root (run it from anywhere) and builds the Bit comparators via 'make -C <root> -B'. GPU visibility for the GPU builds is derived from build.gpu (NVIDIA->CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES, AMD->ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES, INTEL->none); set system_env.gpu_visible_env (e.g. 'CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1') to override.

build._docs: One up-front 'make -B' before the grid. Blank/empty values are OMITTED so Makefile defaults apply. 'gpu' is REQUIRED (use 'NONE' for CPU-only). 'gpu_arch' blank = auto-detect. The GPU comparator (openmp_bit_gpu_FAISS_comp) is only built when gpu != NONE; when gpu == NONE the GPU benchmarks are dropped from the run.

output_parser.comment: Per-iteration extraction. The 'openmp' regex matches the End-to-End rows printed by summarize_results ('Total time for Container - CPU|GPU - OpenMP Filter Total : <ns> ... CPU iteration: <i>'). The 'faiss' regex matches the per-iteration table rows printed by print_iteration_results ('<i> | <ns> | ...').
